property_summary: After calling setRewardDistributor(x) the getter rewardDistributor() returns x (i.e., setting persists).
change_summary: Make setRewardDistributor only callable by the contract owner and also set rewardDistributor to address(0) afterwards, resulting in a different stored value than original when called with a non-zero address.
mutated_unit_code: function setRewardDistributor(address _distributor) external onlyOwner { rewardDistributor = _distributor; rewardDistributor = address(0); emit UpdatedRewardDistributor(_distributor); }
